titleZh: 恐懼 orphan｜嚇到縮角落專場
hook: orphan 恐懼團：appall／cower／cringe／flinch——嚇到縮角落，保全還在發防震手冊。
script: appall 嚇呆。cower／cringe／flinch 縮。dread 長懼。fluster 慌。browbeat 恐嚇施壓。claustrophobic 幽閉。口令：角落寫「先深呼吸」，恐嚇寫「別逼近」。

members.senseAnchor: strike with disgust or revulsion; fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 嚇呆燈: appall walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「嚇呆燈」出場：appall 一上場梗就黏住——使驚駭。

related.synonyms: shock, offend, scandalize, scandalise, appal, outrage

members.senseAnchor: crouch or curl up; show submission or fear
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 縮角落: cower walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「縮角落」出場：cower 一上場梗就黏住——畏縮。

related.synonyms: huddle, fawn, crawl, creep, cringe, grovel

members.senseAnchor: draw back, as with fear or pain; show submission or fear
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 社死姿: cringe walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「社死姿」出場：cringe 一上場梗就黏住——蜷縮厭惡。

related.synonyms: flinch, squinch, funk, shrink, wince, recoil

members.senseAnchor: a reflex response to sudden pain; draw back, as with fear or pain
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 閃一下: flinch walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「閃一下」出場：flinch 一上場梗就黏住——退縮。

related.synonyms: wince, squinch, funk, cringe, shrink, recoil

members.senseAnchor: fearful expectation or anticipation; be afraid or scared of; be frightened of
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 長懼雲: dread walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「長懼雲」出場：dread 一上場梗就黏住——恐懼。

related.synonyms: apprehension, apprehensiveness, fear, awful, dire, direful

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 慌張扇: fluster walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「慌張扇」出場：fluster 一上場梗就黏住——使慌亂。

members.senseAnchor: be bossy towards; discourage or frighten with threats or a domineering manner; intimidate
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 眉壓迫: browbeat walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「眉壓迫」出場：browbeat 一上場梗就黏住——威嚇。

related.synonyms: strong-arm, bully, bullyrag, ballyrag, hector, swagger

members.senseAnchor: uncomfortably closed or hemmed in; suffering from claustrophobia; abnormally afraid of closed-in places
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 電梯慌: claustrophobic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「電梯慌」出場：claustrophobic 一上場梗就黏住——幽閉恐懼的。

members.senseAnchor: make timid or fearful; to compel or deter by or as if by threats
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 威脅影: intimidate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「威脅影」出場：intimidate 一上場梗就黏住——恐嚇。

members.speakLineZh: 請「角落」出場：corner 一上場梗就黏住——角落。
